definitions.gloss: depth, distance from front to back
definitions.explanation: The measurement from the front to the back of an object, room, or space. Also used figuratively to describe richness or profundity.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奥行|おくゆ}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧30⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧です。
examples.english: This shelf has a depth of 30 centimeters.
The room is narrow but has depth.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{奥行|おくゆ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{構図|こうず}→構図：13178_kouzu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{遠近感|えんきんかん}→遠近感：27663_enkinkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: This photo has a composition with depth, and the sense of perspective comes through well.

notes:
WRITING:
⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧ (interior/deep) + {行|ゆ}き (going). Literally "going to the back."

USAGE:
Primarily a spatial measurement term used in architecture, furniture, and interior design. Also used figuratively: {奥行|おくゆ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧ (a work with depth/complexity) or {奥行|おくゆ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧ (a flavor with depth).

When shopping for furniture or appliances in Japan, the three standard dimensions are: ⟦{幅|はば}→幅：03565_haba⟧ (width), ⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧ (height), and {奥行|おくゆ}き (depth).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {奥行|おくゆ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have depth
- {奥行|おくゆ}き30⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧: 30cm deep
- {奥行|おくゆ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: with depth (modifier)
- {奥行|おくゆ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to create a sense of depth
